english.title: Person under 18 supplied with alcohol to his order by / on behalf of club - Licensing
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) being a person under the age of 18, namely **(..SPECIFY THE AGE..) and a member of a club, namely **(..SPECIFY THE CLUB AND LOCATION..), alcohol, namely **(..SPECIFY THE ALCOHOL..), was supplied to you or to your order by or on behalf of the club as a result of your act or default
english.legislation: Contrary to section 149(1)(b)(i) and (7)(a) of the Licensing Act 2003.

english.notes:
As from 08/04/2013 Penalty Notices for Disorder may ONLY be issued to offenders aged 18 years or over.
The Penalty Notice for Disorder rose from £80 to £90 on 01/07/13

Section 149(5) of the Licensing Act 2003 provides that the above offence does not apply where:-
(a) the relevant person is aged 18 or over,
(b) the individual is aged 16 or 17,
(c) the alcohol is beer, wine or cider,
(d) its purchase or supply is for consumption is at a table meal on relevant premises, and (e) the individual is accompanied at the meal by an individual aged 18 or over.

other.penalty:
